title: Measure the Eternity-1 Milestone 1-2 post-IC8 baseline with an objective-driven policy

options.actionStrategy: immediate fixed point before and after every production step

policies.description: objective-driven post-IC8 policy; compound IP by gain-aware resets and clear staged Tower Challenges

researchEffects.formula: normal IP gain × (1 + log10(current IP)); factor is 1 at 0/1 IP
normal IP gain × 3^secondsSinceIC8Clear; raw multiplier cap 1e10; post-softcap power 0.50
normal IP gain × 3^secondsSinceIC8Clear; raw multiplier cap 1e10; post-softcap power 0.25

productionPredicates.ic8TimerRule: representative fixture initialization is IC8 clear = t 0
productionPredicates.errorHandling: exact IP stays BigInt in the production runtime; research multipliers are clamped to the production exact-IP ceiling before normal addInfinityPoints()

fixture.boundary: Eternity 1 / Milestone 1-2 / Achievements 1-41 / IC1-IC8 complete; post-IC8 t = 0
fixture.resetSemantics: fresh runtime state with the listed IU mask, then production resetBelowInfinity()

productionPredicates.ic8TimerRule: representative fixture initialization is IC8 clear = t 0
productionPredicates.errorHandling: exact IP stays BigInt in the production runtime; research multipliers are clamped to the production exact-IP ceiling before normal addInfinityPoints()

fixtureCloning.criterion: every candidate receives a fresh clone of fixture.state

objectivePolicy.actionOrder: normal/IU/IA/TC4 purchases → bounded Tower build → active challenge completion → challenge starts → reward-aware GR → benefit-aware Core Boost → gain-aware Infinity reset
objectivePolicy.resetRule: reach the next IP objective or gain at least the currently held IP; no IP target uses the same gain-aware tie-break
objectivePolicy.generationRule: nextGenerationValues() with a meaningful score-multiplier or cost-factor improvement
objectivePolicy.coreBoostRule: nextCoreBoostValues() benefit while the current objective still needs production
objectivePolicy.failureRule: unfinished human-scale runs return policy-stall diagnostics

outcome.reason: parallel-bc16500-root: major milestone is horizon-bound (tc1-clear); parallel-bc16500-fourth-root: major milestone is horizon-bound (tc1-clear)
